pick.headline: Medicare Drug Rule's Savings Trimmed 96%, Now Bravely Confronts Four Companies
pick.take: The final rule saves 96% less than the proposal and applies to four companies. In pharmacologic terms, that's a dose so diluted it's mostly vehicle. Everyone else in the industry can stand down, having survived the rigors of a comment period.
